summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on the Marian reforms, a set of military reforms of 107 BC. It identifies Gaius Marius, a Roman Republic statesman and general, as the man who initiated them. The note gives no further detail on the reforms' content or effects.
one_line: Overview of the Marian reforms, the 107 BC military reforms of Roman general Gaius Marius.
key_facts: The Marian reforms were a group of military reforms.
The Marian reforms took place in 107 BC.
The Marian reforms were initiated by Gaius Marius.
Gaius Marius was a statesman and general of the Roman Republic.
